verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no explicit update command or auto-update mechanism. The CLI install is pinned (`npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`), and `doctor` only reports the current CLI version. The one implied path is the hosted remote MCP server and shared hosted process service: fixes there would arrive server-side without reinstalling, but the docs never describe this as an update path. Missing for 10: a documented CLI update/upgrade command or procedure, guidance on refreshing generated skill files after upgrades, a changelog or release notes, and explicit documentation that hosted MCP users get fixes automatically.
